newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices stable.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run NWE fuel prices were stable on Monday with little buying interest on a quiet day, traders said.
Offers stood at $108 fob per tonne. Sellers said early indications of buying interest stood at $102 before rising to $105 but no deals were seen done.
Traders said prices for Russian high sulphur material were also stable but cargoes had become harder to find.
"The Russians are hesitant (to sell) at the current price," one said. "But I don't think buying interest is spectacular at the moment either."
